jwtSecret.ok: Sessions are signed with a key set by the administrator.
jwtSecret.ephemeral: No session signing key is set: every restart signs every user out.
jwtSecret.short: The session signing key from {source} is {length} characters long: use at least {minimum} random characters.
jwtSecret.unreadable: The session signing key cannot be read: {reason}

secretsSetTwice.ok: Every secret is set in one place only.
secretsSetTwice.found: Set both directly and through a file: {variables}. The direct value wins and the file is ignored.

instanceKey.unusable: The instance key cannot be used: {reason}
instanceKey.permissions: {path} is open to other users: the folder should be 0700 and the file 0600.
instanceKey.mismatch: The instance key is not the one this instance's data was written with: the hosting panel's backups and scheduled wake-ups are stopped. Put the right key back and restart; for a deliberate change, start once with LIBREFOLIO_INSTANCE_KEY_ACCEPT=1.

sessionCookie.ok: The session cookie is Secure whenever the browser uses HTTPS.
sessionCookie.never: The session cookie is also sent over plain HTTP (SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE=never).

clientAddress.ok: No request has come through a proxy LibreFolio does not trust since the server started.
clientAddress.untrustedProxy: Requests come through a reverse proxy that LibreFolio does not trust ({headers}): the limits per visitor's address do not apply to them. List the proxy in FORWARDED_ALLOW_IPS, or name the header it sets in LIBREFOLIO_CLIENT_IP_HEADER.
clientAddress.publicForwarding: Forwarding headers from a public address were ignored ({headers}). If a proxy on a public address forwards the requests, list it in FORWARDED_ALLOW_IPS; otherwise there is nothing to do.

frameProtection.on: Only LibreFolio's own pages can show it in a frame.
frameProtection.offSelfHosted: Pages at another address, such as your dashboards, can show LibreFolio in a frame: the default of an install of your own.
frameProtection.offManaged: Frame protection is off in the managed profile: any site can show LibreFolio in a frame. Turn LIBREFOLIO_FRAME_PROTECTION on, as the managed profile does by default.

cspReportOnly.on: Besides the policy always enforced, the pages of the web app carry a wider report-only Content-Security-Policy: the browser lists in its console what it would also block, and blocks none of it.
cspReportOnly.offSelfHosted: No report-only Content-Security-Policy: the default of an install of your own.
cspReportOnly.offManaged: The report-only Content-Security-Policy is off in the managed profile: browsers list nothing it would block. Turn LIBREFOLIO_CSP_REPORT_ONLY on, as the managed profile does by default.

logLevel.verbose: The log level is {log_level}: the log records operational detail; INFO is enough in production.

pluginSecrets.ok: The stored plugin secrets can be read with the instance key.
pluginSecrets.unreadable: {count, plural, one {# stored plugin secret cannot be read with the instance key: enter it again in Settings → Plugins, or restore the instance key it was saved with.} other {# stored plugin secrets cannot be read with the instance key: enter them again in Settings → Plugins, or restore the instance key they were saved with.}}

testMode.testLane: Test mode is on, in a lane of the test runner.
testMode.outsideTestLane: Test mode is on outside the test runner: data providers made for the tests are offered, the data are kept in {data_dir} and the .env file is not read. Unset LIBREFOLIO_TEST_MODE.

hostingPanel.off: No token or public key is set for the hosting panel's scheduled wake-up or status route: those routes are off.
hostingPanel.ok: The hosting panel's credentials that are set (tokens of the scheduled wake-up and status route, public keys of the signed tickets) can be used.
hostingPanel.unusable: {variables}: these hosting panel tokens cannot be used (a file that cannot be read, too short, or characters a request header cannot carry): their routes answer 503 until it is fixed.
hostingPanel.ticketsUnusable: {variables}: the hosting panel's signed-ticket settings cannot be used (a malformed public key, a clock tolerance out of 0–300 seconds, or keys without a public address): every route of the panel answers 503 until it is fixed.
hostingPanel.coexisting: {variables}: a hosting panel token is still set beside the panel's public keys. Remove it once the panel signs its calls with tickets.
hostingPanel.audiencePath: LIBREFOLIO_PUBLIC_URL holds the path {path}, but a hosting panel ticket names only the origin (scheme, host and port): another instance on the same origin would accept this one's tickets. Serve one instance per origin.

block.title: This instance is blocked
block.adminDescription: The hosting provider has blocked this instance, for example because its subscription is not paid. Settle it with the provider to unblock the instance.
block.userDescription: The hosting provider has blocked this instance, for example because its subscription is not paid. Ask your administrator for a backup of your data.
block.deletionDate: The instance and its data will be deleted on {date}.
block.backupTitle: Keep a copy of the data

awaitingRestore.title: Restoring your data
awaitingRestore.message: We are putting your data back in place: try again in a few minutes.
awaitingRestore.autoReload: This page reloads by itself when your data is ready.

restoreInterrupted.title: The restore stopped half way
restoreInterrupted.message: LibreFolio cannot tell which data it holds, so it shows none until your administrator chooses how to go on.
restoreInterrupted.adminHint: Administrator: stop LibreFolio, then run ./dev.py backup pending to see what happened and --recover previous to put the data of before back.
restoreInterrupted.autoReload: This page reloads by itself once LibreFolio serves the data again.
restoreInterrupted.ownerTitle: The owner's account is not ready
restoreInterrupted.ownerMessage: The data was restored, but the owner does not have their account yet, so LibreFolio shows none until your administrator sets it.
restoreInterrupted.ownerAdminHint: Administrator: stop LibreFolio, run ./dev.py backup pending --recover owner to set the owner's account again, then start LibreFolio again.
